module.title: Laboratory, Medical Imaging and Clinical Media
module.business_purpose: Connects laboratory and imaging workflows to the patient chart while the heavy binary content remains in PACS/VNA or governed object storage. Supports one report with many result observations, specimens, images and attachments instead of a single file link.
